support.subtitle: Need help? Check our frequently asked questions or get in touch.

support.securityDesc: If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT report it publicly on GitHub. Email us directly so we can address it responsibly.
support.faq1q: Can I recover a message after it's been burned?
support.faq1a: No. Once a message is viewed (burned) or expired, it is deleted from our database and we cannot recover it. We keep no backups of message data of our own.
support.faq2q: I lost my password. Can you recover it?
support.faq2a: No. NoteBurner uses a zero-knowledge architecture. Your password never leaves your device, so we don't have it and cannot recover it for you.
support.faq3a: Yes. The extension encrypts selected text locally on your machine before sending only the encrypted data to our servers. It is open source and can be audited on GitHub.
support.faq4q: How long can a message last?
support.faq4a: You can set messages to expire anywhere from 5 minutes to 7 days (24 hours by default). If not viewed by then, they are automatically deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We believe privacy is a fundamental right. That's why NoteBurner is built with a zero-knowledge architecture.
privacy.overviewText: NoteBurner respects your privacy. Messages are encrypted in your browser before they leave your device, and our servers only ever hold ciphertext. We have no way to decrypt your messages. This policy covers the NoteBurner website and the NoteBurner browser extension.
privacy.doNotCollect1: The password you protect a message with, or any encryption key
privacy.doNotCollect2: Your browsing history, or the pages you visit
privacy.doNotCollect3: Message content in readable form: we only ever hold ciphertext
privacy.doNotCollect4: Your identity when you send a message: sending needs no account
privacy.doNotCollect6: Tracking cookies: we do not set any
privacy.onlyReceive2: The expiry time and self-destruct options you choose
privacy.onlyReceive3: A random access token (not linked to you)
privacy.enc1Desc: All encryption happens in your browser using AES-256-GCM before any data leaves your device.
privacy.enc2Desc: Your password never leaves your device. We store only the encrypted ciphertext. We cannot decrypt your messages even if compelled to do so.
privacy.enc3Desc: All data is transmitted over HTTPS (TLS 1.3) with HSTS enabled.
privacy.retentionDesc: Your data is ephemeral by design. We strictly enforce deletion policies:
privacy.retentionItem1: Burn on read: a message is deleted immediately after its first successful decryption.
privacy.retentionItem2: Expiration: every message has a hard expiry. You can choose from 5 minutes to 7 days in the app (default 24 hours), and the service never keeps a message longer than 30 days.
privacy.retentionItem3: Permanent removal: expired and read messages are purged from our database by an hourly cleanup job. We keep no backups of message data of our own. Our hosting provider may keep short-lived infrastructure recovery data that we cannot shorten.
privacy.questionsDesc: If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact us.
privacy.onlyReceive5: Your IP address, used only for rate limiting and abuse protection, and the country it maps to when a message has a country restriction
privacy.onlyReceive6: If you choose to create an account: your email address and a salted hash of your account password (never the password itself)
privacy.extensionDesc: The extension reads the text you have selected only when you open it or use its right-click menu item. It encrypts that text on your device and sends only the ciphertext to api.noteburner.work. It stores one setting, your dark mode preference, in your browser sync storage. It does not read your browsing history or any other page content.
privacy.retentionItem4: Logs: audit logs and failed-login records are deleted after 30 days. Account data is kept until you delete your account.
